verdict.rationale: Google Voice documents ring groups that let several people answer calls to a shared number. The only ring pattern evidenced is round robin, which rings members in random order, not a fixed sequence. Missing for 10: evidence of simultaneous ringing, a fixed sequential ring order, routing unanswered ring-group calls to voicemail or another number, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can ring a group in order or simultaneously, and route unanswered calls to voicemail or another number

citations.quote: You can set up ring groups to let people in your organization answer calls from the same Google Voice number.
Round robin—Rings each member in random order until someone answers.
